mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, thereby increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% relative to the previous month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 105.0), a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE above 3.8%) signals a supply-driven slowdown in the economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0 and UNRATE > 3.8%, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS above 520,000 million dollars), a concurrent rise in residential construction permits (HOUST above 1300 thousand units) signals a robust housing market, which boosts economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:NAHB Housing and Consumer Spending Reports
regime_hint: strong consumer and housing demand (RSAFS > 520,000 and HOUST > 1300)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 520,000 and HOUST > 1300, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05.
